purpose: Phase-7A extracellular-matrix (ECM) components as PASSIVE structural abstractions. Collagen / hyaluronic acid / proteoglycan / extracellular fluid are represented only by ordinal density / porosity / resistance descriptors with schematic 0-1 values - NOT individual fibres, cross-link chemistry, collagen synthesis/degradation, matrix turnover, fibroblasts, or MMPs. All values are schematic; no ECM fibre density / collagen mass / absolute diffusion coefficient is claimed.

collagen.description: Passive structural network (density / alignment / packing -> porosity + penetration effect). No biosynthesis / degradation / fibroblast activity.

hyaluronic_acid.description: Hydration modifier / diffusion modifier / interstitial resistance modifier only. No enzymatic degradation, HAS enzymes, or hyaluronidase biology.

extracellular_fluid.description: Available extracellular fluid / porosity (higher porosity = lower resistance).

ecm_composite.description: How the components combine into a single passive ECM penetration-resistance (schematic weighted mean). Exposes density / porosity / stiffness / diffusion_resistance / penetration_resistance at runtime.
